facts.fact: A learner's licence is valid for 6 months
facts.quote: What is the validity of Learner License? Learner's License validity is for 6 Months, and you can apply for New Driving License after 30 days.

facts.fact: The holder can apply for the permanent driving licence after 30 days of getting the learner's licence (the LL is valid for 6 months)
facts.quote: After how many days of Learner's License issuance I am eligible to apply Driving License Learner's Licence validity is for 6 months, and you can apply for New Driving Licence after 30 days.

facts.fact: An expired learner's licence cannot be renewed; a new learner's licence must be obtained
facts.quote: Learner's License validity is for 6 Months and post expiry you can only get a new Learner's License. The expired License cannot be renewed.

facts.fact: On Sarathi the new LL after expiry is applied through 'Expired Learner License Issue Again' in the Learner's License menu
facts.quote: Learners' License cannot be renewed and New Learners' License shall be issued. Applicants can visit 1. https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ 2. Select concerned state 3. Click on "Expired Learner License Issue Again" from "Learner's License" menu

facts.fact: The DL is applied on sarathi.parivahan.gov.in after selecting the State, under Driving Licence > 'Apply for Driving Licence'
facts.quote: Learner Licence Driving Licence Conductor Licence Driving School Licence Appointments Upload Document Fee Payments Others Application Status File Your Grievance Apply for Learner Licence Apply for Driving Licence
facts.note: Delhi's Sarathi home page as the example State; menu names can vary by State.

facts.fact: The DL application stages are: fill applicant details, upload documents, upload photo/signature (some States), book the DL test slot, pay the fee, verify payment and take the test
facts.note: On 28 Oct 2026 the checker could not fetch Sarathi's newDLDet.do (IncompleteRead on every attempt, plain and rendered); a person should confirm the stage list there. The Parivahan FAQ gives a shorter version: New Driving Licence > enter LL number and DOB > fill form > Next > visit RTO on the scheduled date with original documents and fee slip.
